record_scope: October 2026 tape-photo analysis of the finished console. old_estimate, param_changes, unchanged_confirmed, shape_changes and their notes describe an initial documentation model and proposed checks at that stage; they are not current model parameters or the pre-build design. The unknown list records limits of this photo set, some later addressed by the scan. Current geometry: 3d/scad/params.scad and docs/GEOMETRY.md.
source: Tape readings from my photos IMG_3449-3482 (3 Oct 2026), cross-checked against the raw readings and photographs, with ranges and confidence retained. Photographs: measurement-photos/. Frame: x across the car from the deck centre line (+ passenger), y along the car from the notch stitch line (+ rear), z up from the deck top. Units mm. Confidence 0-1. Where the tape was laid across the whole deck it rested on the raised side rims (~20 mm above the deck), so deck-level parts read short: in IMG_3457 the 102 plate reads 93, so that photo's deck-level readings are corrected x1.09; IMG_3465 readings are corrected by ~1.5-5%.

param_change_notes.notch_lip_r: Not measured; must change with notch_lip because deck.scad asserts notch_lip_r < notch_lip <= 2*notch_lip_r.
param_change_notes.deck_half_width: 205 between the seams: 200 raw (3465, tape above the deck), ~207 corrected (3457); also makes the cup, plate and slot x positions fit the measured gaps. Low-medium confidence.
param_change_notes.arch_pts: Only the apex was measured (188, raw tape in 3456; 182-193 possible). Old arch shape shifted back 10; end points moved to x = +-deck_half_width so deck.scad adds no extra point.
param_change_notes.seam_rear_y: Derived from the 10 mm arch shift; length along the wing joints not measured.
param_change_notes.wing_height: Away from the rear end; the rear end is ~131.
param_change_notes.wing_outer_x: 219/2, measured at the rear ends with the panel lifted out. Conflicts with the fitted top band near the notch (see shape_changes).
param_change_notes.wing_tip_y: 577 overall length with wing_rear_y kept at 300 (rear position not measured). The tip is probably on the top edge; wings.scad outline code needs changing (see shape_changes).
param_change_notes.bead_d: The black bead strip only; the whole top band is 15-18 wide.
param_change_notes.button_head_d: 15-18. If it is really ~18, the switch is the 16 mm size and button_hole_d should become 16.
param_change_notes.slot_c: x corrected for tape height and checked against the gaps; y unchanged.
param_change_notes.slot_cut: Not measured; kept between opening and surround.
param_change_notes.cup_c: x corrected for tape height; y unchanged.
param_change_notes.cup_ring_id: fittings.scad cup_top_od is 73, leaving a 0.5 cup wall.
param_change_notes.cup_depth: Outside bottom in the model: cup body 64 tall minus ~3.5 ring above the deck; inside floor measured at 57.
param_change_notes.fittings.scad button_face_d: Local variable in fittings.scad, not params.scad; 12-13.5, low confidence.

shape_changes: Wing front end probably reversed: the pointed tip is at the end of the TOP edge; the front edge drops nearly straight for a short way (3-5 mm back at 18 mm down) then curves BACK to the bottom edge (IMG_3450, agrees with IMG_3443). Model has the bead ending at y=-185 and the tip on the bottom edge 80 mm further forward. wing_bead_front_y should equal wing_tip_y, which the current wings.scad outline code cannot take.

Wing top edge stands 19.5-26 above the deck (model ~7.5); the deck sits between raised side rims with pebble-leatherette inner faces (IMG_3473, IMG_3474). wings.scad bottom_z = -(wing_height - 8) assumes +8; with the top at ~+23 and height 147 the bottom edge is at z ~ -121 to -127 (model -142). Suggest new variable wing_top_z ~ 23.

Top edge is a 15-18 wide band (leatherette fold/roll ~5-7.5, clear rod ~3-4 lying on top - most likely the side-glow fibre, narrow strip ~2-3, black bead ~5), not an 8 mm round bead on a ~4.3 board. The side-glow fibres run along the tops of the rims; separate LED heads underneath feed their ends. See docs/PROJECT-DETAILS.md.
Wing rear end ~131 high vs ~144-147 elsewhere (drop ~13-16; model ~10). The straight edge is probably the top edge; the curved edge is the seat-side bottom edge.

Notch is ~150 wide at the open edge near the back corners (~155 crease to crease) and widens toward the front ~6-7 deg per side (~165 about 60 mm forward); model has parallel arms at x=+-75. Corner radius ~10-20.

Deck width probably constant (~205): the earlier 'narrows from 209 to 190' reading came from IMG_3457's tape lying on the side rims (190 raw, ~207 corrected) and from the 209 running to a different passenger-side line. Not confirmed.

Clock: a dark ring shows OUTSIDE the chrome bezel (outline ~36, chrome ~34); fittings.scad has the black skirt (clock_skirt_d 33) smaller than and under the bezel. If the ring belongs to the clock, the skirt becomes ~36 outside the bezel; if it is the hole wall in the leatherette, only a 36 hole is needed.
Cup is deeper: floor at z ~ -57; cup body reaches ~60 below the deck top (~48 below the felt).

Wing position across the car not settled: wing outer faces 219 apart at the rear ends (lifted out), but near the notch (fitted) the fibres on the top band are 233 apart and the band's outer edges ~250 apart. Either the band overhangs the wings outward by ~10-15 per side, the wings lean out at the top when fitted, or the two places differ. wing_outer_x 109.5 follows the rear-end reading only.
Two LED heads are at the rear arch corners under the deck feeding the fibres; the third head lies loose in the gear-lever well with no fibre.
Felt step across the underside near the notch line: the main deck may be thicker than the arms (inferred).
Metal bar under the slot is ~4.5:1 length:width in IMG_3481/3482, not 36x114 (3.2:1); likely ~20-25 wide (not tape-measured).

materials.item: Deck board: tan-brown fine even fibreboard, no plies or grain, bare at the passenger notch arm edge
Cable-clip screws go straight into the board through the felt
Deck top: black pebble-grain leatherette
Underside: black needle-felt
Top leatherette wraps over the rear arch onto the underside, meeting the felt edge
Notch back edge: rolled leatherette lip ~5 wide with stitched crease
Straight step in the felt near the notch line
Notch lining: separate leatherette strip with grey knit backing, raw cut edge, hanging loose
Notch lining not stuck to the board edge along the passenger arm
Wing boards ~4.3 thick; one rear end shows a bare smooth grey edge
Wing outer faces leatherette; inner faces bare matte black with scuffs and small coating cracks
Whitish residue band on the driver wing inner face
No brackets, hinges or screws at the visible wing-to-deck joints
Rim inner face above the deck: pebble leatherette topped by a smooth black band ~5
Top-edge band: zigzag-stitched leatherette fold, clear glossy rod, narrow strip, black bead
Side-glow fibre runs along the top band
Two aluminium LED heads under the deck at the rear arch corners
Fibre with flat fin held by a screwed nylon P-clip just ahead of each head, curling over the rear corner
Third LED head loose in the gear-lever well, no fibre
LED controller on the outside bottom of the cup body; label specifies INPUT DC 5-12V
Cup insert: separate black cup, closed flat floor with central boss, no screws
Chrome ring: rolled half-round lip ~5 wide
Socket plate: black plastic panel, USB CHARGER socket front, red-ringed 12 V socket rear, 4 Phillips screws; 12 V cap torn
12 V socket rear: zinc threaded cup, yellow fibre insulator, clear nylon push-on connectors stacked on centre terminal
Slot surround: black moulded plastic bezel, rims ~4.2
Black-painted metal bar under the slot, with rounded corners and two holes, capping a block below the felt
Flat-faced silver metal push button; it latches down to keep the lights on
Clock dial carries a Toyota emblem, 12 toward the front
Power cable: round black sheath, plain cut end, blue + brown (salmon-looking) wires to the socket terminals; enters beside the slot's metal bar, leaves at the driver-side notch corner
Red/black paired wire, black heat-shrink joints, ribbed multi-pin plugs on LED cables, black strap screwed to the board
No fuse holder, relay or converter on the visible underside
Two red wire ends at the front passenger corner beneath the button; no terminal continuity recorded
Red/black lead with small in-line plug clipped along the passenger arm toward the tray
Cigarette-lighter plug with knurled screw-off tip and right-angle exit, held unplugged by the gear lever
Small perforated black cylinder on a cable beside the slot bar; shown for position only
Every visible underside screw holds a cable clip or strap to the panel; none goes into the car

Conflict: along-car positions near the notch. Plate front ~42 (3455) vs ~49-52 (3456); clock centre 21.5 (3455) vs ~25-28 (3456) vs ~34 (3469, steep).
Conflict: deck width 200 raw (3465, tape above deck) vs ~207 corrected (3457) vs ~209 at the notch line to a possibly different line (3468+3469). 205 used.
Conflict: wing outer faces 219 apart at the rear ends (lifted out) vs top-band fibres 233 apart and outer edges ~250 apart near the notch (fitted).
Cup ring OD: 84 in the two close-ups and in 3457 after correction; 3465 gives 79 (edge carried 40 mm from the tape). Mostly settled.
Clock bezel: 32.6 in the close-up (3455) vs ~36 in 3456 and 3469.
Wing height 147 edge to edge (3461) vs ~144-145 in 3460 once the 2-4 mm hook gap is allowed for.
Wing top height above deck 26 (3473) vs 19.5 (3474): varies along the wing or different features.
Wing length 577 assumes the hook was on the wing's rear end (hook not in photo).
Which wing and which point along it in the wing-height photos (3458-3461).
Unreadable: red wire printing, cable-clip markings, in-line plug pin counts, USB socket body labels.
The packaged IMG_3450.jpg, IMG_3455.jpg and IMG_3463.jpg are usable. IMG_3470, IMG_3471 and IMG_3475 are not included.

drawing_assumptions.switch: Positive-side interruption is the drawing assumption; latching operation is confirmed.
drawing_assumptions.qi_return: Concealed return routing is dashed in the installed drawing.

fit_and_operation.panel_fit: I sized the panel from measurements of the existing centre console to sit over it, with clearance for the components underneath.
fit_and_operation.button_operation: When I press the silver button, it remains depressed and keeps the lights on after release.
fit_and_operation.remaining_switch_detail: The terminal routing and switched conductor are not confirmed; the installed drawing assumes a positive-side interruption.
fit_and_operation.design_need: Raise the working surface from the low factory centre console, provide useful phone space, integrate charging without a protruding adapter, and add lights.
fit_and_operation.clock_power: The clock runs on its own battery, independently of the console supply.
